title: The Secret Group Chat
author: Sable Iversen
blurb: Marguerite Eriksen, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before the last game of the season.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
